title: Sidebar: hovering a bot row no longer wraps its name or changes the row's height
body:
Oleks, 18:46 UTC: hovering a bot flickers because its name goes onto a new line.

**Cause.** On hover or focus the name line got `pr-9` to make room for Edit and Remove. With a badge such as "Needs you" next to a short name, that squeezed the name. `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]` then broke it mid-word ("Anal / yst"), and the row grew from 52 to 72 px.

**Fix** (`frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx`):
- The name line no longer changes on hover.
- Edit and Remove (`data-bot-row-actions`) now sit at `bottom-2`: the right end of the one-line status under the name.
- That status line (`truncate`, both the title and busy variants) gets the hover `pr-9` instead. It never wraps, so hover trims a few letters of the status, not the row's height. The 0.6.3 rule still holds: buttons never cover letters.
- Phone rows are unchanged.

**Checks**
- `tsc` clean. `npm test` 1274 pass / 0 fail (1 skipped).
- `polish063` test 3 rewritten. The name line has no hover classes. The buttons sit at `bottom-2` with no `top-*`. The status line is `truncate` and carries the hover padding. Phone rows have neither.
- Real Chromium, built CSS, 4 rows at 240/260/280 px:
  - before: Analyst + Needs you goes 52→72 px on hover (name 20→40);
  - after: every row is steady and the buttons sit inside the status line, clear of the name line.
  - Harness and picture: `/home/maus/shared/ship-software-safely/row-hover/` (render.mjs, hover.mjs, before-after.png).
